reserveReview.rationale: KPMG's unmodified examination as of September 30, 2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time, dated October 23, reconciles 435,306 PAXG redeemable tokens (432,506 Ethereum, 2,560 Solana, 5 Robinhood and 235 Base) to 435,306 fine troy ounces of London Good Delivery gold. Exhibits A-C report no nonredeemable tokens, timing adjustments, or surplus/deficit. Exhibit B identifies allocated gold as the sole redemption asset type and names Brink's Global Services Ltd. and ICBC Standard Bank as LBMA-approved vault providers without provider-level ounce shares.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG examination of PAXG redemption assets and redeemable tokens as of September 30, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reserve asset type is independently examined as allocated London Good Delivery gold. The report names Brink's Global Services Ltd. and ICBC Standard Bank as the LBMA-approved vault providers but does not disclose the ounces held with each provider.

The August 2026 report does not disclose provider-level gold shares, vault-account identifiers, or explicit rehypothecation terms.
